_comment: Sample headless XMPP run configuration. Use this when the simulator should sign in to an XMPP server as a client and publish replay data to a recipient.
_usage: Copy this file, adjust the values, add the passwords, then launch with config=/absolute/path/to/your-launch-config.json. CLI values override config-file values.

connection._comment: protocol=xmpp defaults mode to client and port to 5222 unless they are set explicitly. ip is the shared host key for every protocol, including XMPP. A user@domain xmppUsername overrides xmppDomain.
connection._socketPayload_comment: These inactive defaults document the Simulator-only CSV source conversion keys used when protocol is TCP or UDP. Formats default to delimited; header flags default to false; X/Y fields are optional but paired; WKID defaults to 4326.
connection._xmppConversation_comment: Use conversation=direct with xmppDestination for one recipient, or conversation=room with xmppRoom and xmppNickname to publish into a Multi-User Chat room.
connection._xmppTlsPolicy_comment: STARTTLS policy: required aborts before SASL when the server does not offer STARTTLS, preferred upgrades when offered, disabled never upgrades.
connection._xmppPassword_comment: Add xmppPassword (and xmppRoomPassword for a protected room) by hand or pass it on the command line. It is read from this file but is never written back by Save Launch Configuration. An empty string is accepted for a local test with no shared secret.

headless._comment: Headless mode runs without creating the normal Electron UI.

output._comment: Optional logging and completion artifacts for automation.

streaming._comment: Replay one line per second and exit when the file is complete.
